result.rationale: Diff shows `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` followed by `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar"` with no optional chaining. If destinationCalendar is `[]` (now a common fallback, e.g. handleNewBooking sets `[]`/null in some paths), destructuring yields undefined and `.integration` throws TypeError. The old code `evt.destinationCalendar?.integration` was null-safe.
